packaged_self_test_assertions: an unverified MAIN selected through the interactive path invokes confirmation and disables Filter 2/LFO2 when accepted
the exact verified OS 1.72 MAIN retains Filter 2/LFO2 without invoking confirmation
the bundled QEMU machine, photographic resources, native Tk control drawer, and diagnostic path remain valid
source_regression_assertions: declining the interactive fallback exits cleanly with status zero
an explicit command-line MAIN mismatch remains strict and directs the user to --no-filter2
firmware selection and file validation complete before creation of the runtime directory
preparation failures remove the runtime directory unless --keep-runtime is set
ELE3 extraction metadata exposes hardware and version without redistributing firmware
safety_boundary: Filter 2/LFO2 is enabled only for the exact verified OS 1.72 MAIN digest. A different valid update can boot only through an explicit interactive confirmation and is passed to QEMU unchanged with the emulator-only extension disabled.
scope_limit: This gate proves the fallback decision logic executes inside both frozen macOS architectures and that the resulting packages pass the existing structure, architecture, signature-seal, and firmware-exclusion audit. It does not execute a proprietary non-1.72 firmware image, prove compatibility with every Elektron update, provide Apple Developer ID notarization, or validate physical hardware.
